text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The victor of the Satsuki Sho wasn't 
either of the expected stars—both Admire 
Vega and Narita Top Road missed out on 
first place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"...However, the true reason for the 
turmoil in this race was neither the 
weather nor a lack of preparation, but 
rather—her presence—"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—TM Opera O. Having shown a spirit-filled 
run, she proclaimed that in the end, the 
King would conquer all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next race is the Japanese Derby (Tokyo 
Yushun). Against her idolized star and the 
unveiled Supreme Overlord, Narita Top Road 
steps up to challenge them once again!
